# Web archive fixtures (synthetic)

Synthetic responses that follow the published formats of the Time Travel aggregator
(JSON TimeMap), the Internet Archive (link-format TimeMap and CDX JSON), the UK Web Archive
and archive.today (link-format TimeMaps) and the Common Crawl CDX index (JSON lines). They
are **not recorded live responses**. `example.org` URLs, timestamps and digests are
invented. Live evidence belongs to WA15 (#2348). Used by `tests/unit/web_archive_harness.py`.
